notes.title: Version 1.2.3 is now live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.3 is now live!

I've reduced the issue where unintended input noise could occur when releasing the stick.
Now, small stick movements will be ignored to help prevent accidental inputs.

These changes are aimed at reducing unintentional control errors.
Tiny input noise caused by stick rebound has been removed.

Welcome your feedback on how the controls feel—good or bad.
Any other feedback is also greatly appreciated.

Please continue to enjoy the brain-breaking experience!

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Gamepad controls added and updated.
notes.notes:
To improve the gamepad experience, I’ve added new control options and changed the menu button.
Keyboard controls remain the same.

New gamepad inputs:

[list]
[*] Left hand: Left stick, D-Pad
[*] Right hand: Right stick, right-side buttons (XYAB / ⚪︎△□×)
[*] Open menu: Start button(XBox:Menu/Switch:+/DualShock:Option)
[/list]

Stick controls still work as before.
Added button-only input for players who prefer not to use sticks.

Feel free to share your impressions on the community board or X!
Keep improving based on your feedback.

Enjoy the brain-bending experience!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Released! I've transitioned to a new ranking!
notes.notes:
Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands
Version 1.1.0 has been released.
With fixes to controls and gimmicks, I have transitioned to a new ranking system.

Normal Mode > NormalModeTimeRecordRanking
Hard Mode > HardModeTimeRecordRanking

The updates are as follows:

[list]
[*] Transition to a new ranking system (NormalModeTimeRecordRanking/HardModeTimeRecordRanking).
[*] Achievement improvement: Unlock all lower achievements when obtaining Achievement A.
[*] Adjusted jump detection on falling platforms.
[*] Adjusted button position on the title screen when continuing a game.
[*] Processed time measurement adjustments.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of "Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands"

notes.title: Major Update! Hard Mode Added!
notes.notes:
"Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands Major Update Released!
I'm thrilled that so many of you have been enjoying the game.
As a token of our gratitude, we’ve added exciting new features: Hard Mode and new characters.

Here are the updates:

[list]
[*] Added Hard Mode.
[*] Introduced new characters: Bright the Clown and Leftia the Maid.
[*] Added achievements for Hard Mode.
[*] Fixed the behavior of snow.
[*] Corrected typographical errors.
[*] Added a button on the title screen to link to the rankings.
[/list]

Since the new features are quite challenging, I plan to adjust them based on your feedback.

Thank you for playing!
Take on Hard Mode at your own pace, and enjoy the challenge.

I appreciate your continued support for "Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands"!

notes.title: The full version has been released!
notes.notes:
Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands Full Version Released!

This game is a nerve-wracking run-and-action experience where you control the left hand with your left hand and the right hand with your right hand. Enjoy the mind-bending challenge!

After starting with the demo version and progressing through Early Access, I am thrilled to announce the release of the full version.
I deeply appreciate the players who supported us by playing the demo and Early Access versions. Thank you!
Your feedback has helped us improve the game and fix issues.

Please enjoy this mind-bending challenge.
Thank you for your support of Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands!
